title: Set Up: Plant Parts We Eat

scenes.tts: Every plant food we eat is a part of a plant. Roots, stems, leaves, flowers, and fruits each have a job. A carrot is a root, and lettuce is a leaf. Sort the foods to find which part each one is.

items.text: Every plant food is a plant part
Each plant part has a job

scenes.narration: Every plant food we eat is a part of a plant. Roots, stems, leaves, flowers, and fruits each have a job. A carrot is a root, and lettuce is a leaf. Sort the foods to find which part each one is.

scenes.tts: You need a big sheet of paper and markers, and foods from the grocery store. Get a carrot, lettuce, broccoli, an apple, and a tomato. Add a potato and celery as trick cards.
scenes.narration: You need a big sheet of paper and markers, and foods from the grocery store. Get a carrot, lettuce, broccoli, an apple, and a tomato. Add a potato and celery as trick cards.

scenes.tts: Draw a plant with roots, stem, leaves, flower, and fruit. An adult washes the food and cuts the apple and tomato in half. Your child places each food on the drawing, and guesses its part.
scenes.narration: Draw a plant with roots, stem, leaves, flower, and fruit. An adult washes the food and cuts the apple and tomato in half. Your child places each food on the drawing, and guesses its part.

scenes.tts: Look for clues. Seeds inside means fruit, so a tomato is a fruit. A potato is not a root. It is an underground stem.
scenes.narration: Look for clues. Seeds inside means fruit, so a tomato is a fruit. A potato is not a root. It is an underground stem.

scenes.tts: Stay with your child while food is out. An adult does all the cutting. Check for allergies before anyone tastes anything.
scenes.narration: Stay with your child while food is out. An adult does all the cutting. Check for allergies before anyone tastes anything.

scenes.line: Every plant food is a plant part, and each part has a job.
